This is first bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No.71/2024 dated : 23/2/2024 registered at P.S. - Jaora City District - Ratlam for offences punishable under Sections 420, 201 of IPC.
2.

As per prosecution case, on 23-2-2024 complainants lodged report at police Station Jaora city that co-accused showing himself as Director of Virtuoso Trade and services pvt. Ltd. got deposited Rs 15 lakh security amount for the installation of Solar Plant and entered into agreement.

sentences.text:
In the account of Dipak Rs. 20,85,000/- and in the account of applicant Rs.
35,08,864/- was deposited.
At present in frozen account of applicant Rs 27,66,014/- is lying.
3. Counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant was working as director of the company and co-accused Deepak Verma was working in the field.
Thus, the main allegation is against co-accused Deepak.
The applicant is an ex Indian Army personnel.

4. Counsel for the State and objector opposes the prayer for grant of bail and submits that the aforesaid amount of Rs.35,08,864/- has been received in the account of the applicant by RTGS from various beneficiaries for installation of solar plant.
5.

Counsel for the applicant submit that the he is ready to deposit balance amount of Rs.7,50,000/-
and he has no objection to disburse the aforesaid amount by the Trial Court to various complainants/beneficiaries after verifying their claim.
6.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the aforesaid submission, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail on the condition that the applicant shall deposit balance amount of Rs.7,50,000/- within 15 days from the date of release in the Trial Court failing which this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically.

The trial court shall pass necessary orders for releasing the seized amount from the applicant's account and shall disburse the total amount of Rs.35,08,864/- to various complainants after verifying their complaint and after taking appropriate surety of the said amount from the complainants within a period of 60 days from the date of deposit of balance amount.

7. It is directed that applicant Choleshwar Ratne shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Ld. Court below.
8. A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the Ld. Court below.
9. With the aforesaid, the application is allowed and disposed off.
Cc as per rules.
